4772-5254-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4772-5254-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
4772-5254-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-6006--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1626-3249-6006--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-6006--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

2440-3263-4183-7895.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-4183-7895.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1003-3558-4668-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3558-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

364-1987-4823.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-4823.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-4823.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1322-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-1322-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6797-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-5003-7337.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Baxter Stockman, adding {C}{C}.
When Baxter Stockman dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Baxter Stockman from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Baxter Stockman enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

104-560-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-560-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

512-1336-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Heronblade Elite, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-1336-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

4311-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1170-1329-3200-4894.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Breaching Hippocamp.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2653-4772-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-4772-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3581-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1805-1978-3488.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Katsumasa.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

4200-6132-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
4200-6132-6798.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

647-1270-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1496-2034-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1496-2034-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Verdant Sun's Avatar indestructible.
1496-2034-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1750-1980-5530-6346.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
1750-1980-5530-6346.description:
Cast Shiko either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{R}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Shiko enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Another Round from your graveyard and casting a copy of it without paying its mana cost.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying the Another Round spell.
Resolve the first copy of Another Round, blinking Shiko.
When Shiko enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Pull from Eternity from your graveyard and casting a copy of it without paying its mana cost.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying the Pull from Eternity spell.
Resolve both copies of Pull from Eternity, returning the original Pull from Eternity and Another Round from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the second copy of Another Round from step 2, blinking Shiko.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2493-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

2265-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2265-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

654-730-880.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-730-880.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3276-3496-4071-4875.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3179-3470-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield as a Forest land creature due to Ashaya, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-2757-5089.notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.You control at least one basic Plains.
512-2757-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, turning Halo Fountain into an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untaaping a basic Plains you control.
Activate a basic Plains you control by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Halo Fountain by tapping and untapping itself, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1878-3368.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in their hand.
1878-3368.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Jeska's Will and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

937-3859-4695.description:
During your upkeep, activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
